title: Find a Matcha Flavoured Server
h1: How to Choose a Matcha Flavoured Server: Europe, Crossplay and No Pay-to-Win
description: How to choose a Matcha Flavoured Minecraft server: what to check for server-side install, pay-to-win, platforms and crossplay. Gilly SMP is one European option.
intro: Looking for a server that already runs the Matcha Flavoured datapack? This guide lists what to check before you pick one, and shows how one European crossplay server answers each point. Gilly SMP is used as the worked example.

items.q: What should I check before joining a Matcha Flavoured server?
items.a: Check whether the datapack is installed server-side so you don't have to install anything, whether the server is pay-to-win, how many players it holds, where it is hosted and which platforms it supports. Gilly SMP is hosted in France, is non pay-to-win and holds up to 20 players.

items.q: Is there a European Matcha Flavoured server I can join?
items.a: Gilly SMP is hosted in France and runs the Matcha Flavoured survival rework on the server. Players in the US get around 100 ms. Connect with mc.gillyb.net on Java 26.3, or on Bedrock with port 19132.

items.q: Can I join a Matcha Flavoured server without installing the datapack?
items.a: Yes, on Gilly SMP. The datapack runs on the server, so Java players only add mc.gillyb.net and join with Minecraft 26.3. The server sends its resource pack automatically when you connect; accept the prompt to see custom item names and textures.

items.q: Is there a Matcha Flavoured server with Java and Bedrock crossplay?
items.a: Gilly SMP is one. Java, Bedrock and console players share one world, and /linkaccount lets you link two accounts so progress is shared. Bedrock can't load the Java resource pack, so custom items show vanilla textures there, though every mechanic works.

items.q: Can I play a Matcha Flavoured server on Xbox, PlayStation or Switch?
items.a: On Gilly SMP, yes. Add GillySMP as a friend on your console and join from the Friends tab. Your console maker requires an online subscription. Console players can use /menu for the most common commands.

items.q: How do I join a Matcha Flavoured server with crossplay?
items.a: On Java, add mc.gillyb.net with Minecraft 26.3 and accept the resource pack prompt. On Bedrock, add mc.gillyb.net on port 19132. On console, add GillySMP as a friend. Run /linkaccount if you play on more than one platform.

items.q: Is there a non pay-to-win Matcha Flavoured server?
items.a: Gilly SMP is non pay-to-win. The store only sells cosmetics and quality-of-life items, and ranks grant convenience perks such as more homes and ender chest rows. The economy is player-driven: you earn points by selling to other players.

items.q: Is there a casual, slow-paced Matcha Flavoured survival server?
items.a: Gilly SMP is built for casual and adult players who don't want mob farms, XP farms or villager trading halls. It runs on Easy, natural regeneration is off, and progression is guided by advancements, so you can take your time.
